name: print-social-carbon-footprint-tips-story-phone-mockup-cyan-pink
title: '5 Tips to Reduce Your Carbon Footprint' story shown in a phone mockup with a flat green-planet illustration
whatItIs: A vertical Instagram story shown in a black phone frame: a flat illustration of a green half-planet with wind turbines and buildings on a pink-to-navy sky, above a cyan panel listing five underlined eco tips (eat more plant foods, switch to low-carbon energy, reduce/reuse/recycle, energy-efficient appliances, second-hand clothes) with small icon accents.
whatItMeans: Optimistic and actionable; a friendly illustrated planet makes a climate message feel hopeful rather than alarming.
techniques: Illustrate the earth as a simplified, friendly half-globe.
Underline each tip individually for scannability.
Pair each list item with a small relevant icon.

vocabulary.definition: A short, scannable set of actionable suggestions.
A simplified, stylised depiction of the earth.
